description: Initial 20-standard prototype dataset for SIH 2026 PS 108, focused on rotating electrical machines. Fields are populated only from BIS sources checked during research; unverified fields remain null/empty.
source_note: Primary source: BIS Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors. Current-version/status checks additionally use BIS Know Your Standard, BIS Archive Standard of the Month, and BIS LIMS where available.

standards.title: Rotating Electrical Machines – Part 1: Rating and Performance (Excluding Machines for Traction Vehicles)
standards.scope: Core standard for essential performance parameters and rating methods of rotating electrical machines; covers general-purpose AC and DC machines, including temperature rise, output ratings, duty types, efficiency and other performance metrics.
standards.status: Published; listed in BIS electric-motors compendium as identical under single numbering.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Line-Operated Three-Phase a.c. Motors – Efficiency Classes and Performance Specification (IE Code)
standards.scope: Specifies efficiency classifications, testing methods, losses and performance benchmarks for line-operated three-phase AC motors.
standards.status: A newer BIS revision, IS 12615:2026, is listed in the current BIS archive; the 2018 edition should not be treated as the latest version.

source.document: BIS Archive Standard of the Month; BIS Electric Motors Compendium

standards.title: Single Phase a.c. Induction Motors for General Purpose – Specification
standards.scope: Covers constructional, performance and test requirements for single-phase induction motors, including duty types, ratings, starting methods and mechanical design details.
standards.status: A newer BIS revision, IS 996:2025 (Fourth Revision), is currently listed in BIS sources; the 2009 edition should not be treated as the latest version.

source.document: BIS Know Your Standard / BIS LIMS; BIS Electric Motors Compendium

standards.title: Line Operated A.C. Motors for Submersible Pump Sets – Specification (Third Revision)
standards.scope: Specifies design, construction and performance of AC motors used for submersible pump sets, including single-phase and three-phase motors and oil-filled and water-filled types; addresses submerged operation, sealing and thrust-bearing requirements.
standards.status: Published; Third Revision.
standards.certification: BIS product-manual material is listed for IS 9283:2024.

source.document: BIS Product Manuals; BIS Electric Motors Compendium

standards.title: Three-Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Motors for Centrifugal Pumps for Agricultural Application – Specification (First Revision)
standards.scope: Requirements for three-phase squirrel-cage induction motors used to drive centrifugal water pumps in agriculture, including motor rating, voltage range, high-ambient-temperature design, overload capacity and mechanical features.
standards.status: Published; First Revision; BIS standards portal shows it as reviewed in 2026.

source.document: BIS Know Your Standard; BIS Electric Motors Compendium

standards.title: Single-Phase Small AC Electric Motors for Centrifugal Pumps for Agricultural Applications
standards.scope: Covers small-capacity single-phase induction motors used with shallow-well or surface-mounted centrifugal pumps, including starting torque, voltage tolerance, capacitor specifications and thermal protection.
standards.status: Published; BIS standards portal shows it as reviewed in 2026.

source.document: BIS Know Your Standard; BIS Electric Motors Compendium

standards.title: Three-Phase Induction Motors for Use in Nuclear Power Plants – Specification
standards.scope: Specifies design, construction and testing requirements for induction motors used in nuclear power installations, including enhanced safety, reliability and environmental qualification considerations.
standards.status: Under revision according to the BIS electric-motors compendium.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Single-Speed Three-Phase Induction Motors for Driving Lifts – Specification (First Revision)
standards.scope: Specifies performance and constructional requirements for single-speed three-phase induction motors used in lift applications, including duty, thermal classification, starting current, torque, vibration, insulation and protection classes.
standards.status: Published; First Revision; BIS standards portal shows it as reviewed in 2024.

source.document: BIS Know Your Standard; BIS Electric Motors Compendium

standards.title: Electric Traction Motor – Performance and Functional Requirements
standards.scope: Establishes performance and functional requirements for electric traction motors, including safety, environmental suitability, electromagnetic compatibility and durability.
standards.status: Published.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Rotating Electrical Machines – Part 2: Determining Losses and Efficiency from Tests – Section 1: Standard Methods (Excluding Machines for Traction Vehicles)
standards.scope: Specifies standardized direct and indirect test methods for determining total losses and efficiency of rotating electrical machines, with methods including input-output, loss summation and calorimetric approaches.
standards.status: Published; identical under single numbering.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Guide for Testing Three-Phase Induction Motors (First Revision)
standards.scope: Guidance for type, routine and special tests of three-phase induction motors, including insulation resistance, winding resistance, no-load/full-load, vibration, noise and heating tests.
standards.status: Under revision according to the BIS electric-motors compendium.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Guide for Testing Direct Current (DC) Machines (First Revision)
standards.scope: Test procedures for DC motors and generators, including commutation, insulation, armature reaction, temperature rise and efficiency tests.
standards.status: Published; First Revision; BIS standards portal shows it as reviewed in 2025.

source.document: BIS Know Your Standard; BIS Electric Motors Compendium

standards.title: Guide for Testing Single-Phase AC and Universal Motors
standards.scope: Specifies procedures for testing small single-phase AC motors and universal motors, including performance, dielectric strength, efficiency and thermal-limit checks.
standards.status: Under revision according to the BIS electric-motors compendium.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Mechanical Vibration of Rotating Electrical Machines with Shaft Heights 56 mm and Higher – Measurement, Evaluation and Limits of Vibration Severity
standards.scope: Details measurement and assessment of vibration severity in rotating electrical machines with shaft heights of 56 mm and higher, including limits used to prevent mechanical damage and bearing/structural problems.
standards.status: Published; modified adoption of IEC 60034-14:2018.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Permissible Limits of Noise Levels for Rotating Electrical Machines
standards.scope: Defines measurement procedures and permissible noise limits for rotating electrical machines under standard operating conditions.
standards.status: Published; modified adoption of IEC 60034-9:2021.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Dimensions and Output Series of Foot-Mounted Induction Motors – Frame Numbers 56 to 315 L (Fourth Revision)
standards.scope: Specifies frame sizes, mounting dimensions and shaft details for foot-mounted squirrel-cage induction motors, supporting dimensional compatibility and interchangeability.
standards.status: Published; Fourth Revision.

source.document: ETD 15 Program of Work / referred Indian standards; BIS Electric Motors Compendium

standards.title: Dimensions of Flange-Mounted AC Induction Motors
standards.scope: Covers flange mounting dimensions (including B5 and B14 arrangements) of AC induction motors for compact applications such as gearboxes or pumps.
standards.status: Under revision according to the BIS electric-motors compendium.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Designation of Methods of Cooling for Rotating Electrical Machines
standards.scope: Establishes a coded system for identifying cooling methods used in electrical machines, supporting thermal-performance classification and motor selection.
standards.status: Published; identical adoption of IEC 60034-6.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Rotating Electrical Machines – Part 5: Degrees of Protection Provided by the Integral Design (IP Code) – Classification
standards.scope: Specifies enclosure protection levels against ingress of solid objects and water for rotating electrical machines using IP classification.
standards.status: Published; identical under single numbering.

source.document: Compendium of Indian Standards on Electric Motors

standards.title: Guide on Effects of Unbalanced Voltages on the Performance of Three-Phase Cage Induction Motors (First Revision)
standards.scope: Guidance on the effects of voltage unbalance on the performance, efficiency and thermal behavior of three-phase squirrel-cage induction motors, including quantification and derating considerations.
standards.status: Published; First Revision; BIS standards portal shows it as reviewed in 2025.

source.document: BIS Know Your Standard; BIS Electric Motors Compendium
